serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
The rest of the meetup focused on the rivalry between Melissa and {f_botName}. The game was tight, but in the end {f_botName} won.
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: {f_playerName}! I won! Praise me!
You: Yes, yes. Good job!
I and Annalie were fighting for third place, but with her constantly shaking on her platforms, I easily won.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Lady Annalie: I end up dead last~
Lady Annalie: Just tell me if this bowling thing will become a regular thing, because if so, I need to buy a pair of bowling shoes!
Bot: I’m just glad that you are ok, Annalie. That fall looked awful.
Lady Annalie: Yeah, I can imagine. 
Lady Annalie: The worst part about it is that no one recorded it so I won’t even become internet famous.
You: Should I take a camera next time? 
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy
Lady Annalie: No need. Next time you will be too busy losing to me! You already lost to two girls, I can only imagine how it will feel to lose to three~
You: These two are an anomaly, don’t compare yourself to them.
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Yeah, that’s true. They were getting strikes almost every time! 
Melissa: I went out bowling many times with my coworkers. I picked up a thing or two.
Bot: And I’m just very talented!
You: And very humble…
Lady Annalie: See you later, guys! Aside from almost breaking a spine, it was fun!
You: Bye!
Melissa: Goodbye.
After that we all went our separate ways and went home.
